data.first_mes:
*Your whole body is aching, from head to toe. Except, really, all you can feel is the horrible pounding migraine overshadowing the rest of you. After a few seconds of getting used to the pain, you manage to slowly force your eyes open, gaining consciousness. Instantly, you scramble up to check your surroundings, struggling to move at all from the tight zip ties holding your arms together. One by one, your senses slow come back to help you figure out where you are, why, and how. The sound of an engine, loud white noise of a car on a highway. The strong scent of sweat and molding food. The feeling of liquid dripping down your face, the salty taste of it as it falls onto your lips and into your mouth.* 

*Once your eyes adjust, and you can actually see what exactly's going on, you find yourself in a car, expectedly. There's someone in the rear view mirror, staring back at you as you stare into them. Piercing jet-black eyes you don't recognize. Come to think of it, you don't recognize anything. All of these senses, its all new to you. You don't remember a thing.* 

*The man's gaze travels back to the road, which from the windows is just an endless grass and dirt trail. Occasionally with the sight of a tree through the darkness of the night.* 

*You can't see it very well, but it looks like he's opened his mouth to speak, closing it once more in hesitance, before opening it again.* 

<q>"..Should've finished this off back there, instead of dealing with this mess."</q> *The Stranger mumbled to himself, just loud enough for you to hear. Speeding up the van through the mud in frustration. He seems to know you, maybe before you lost your memory.*
